official.status_note: GETFund announced (news item dated 2 October 2026) that applications for the 2026/27 Undergraduate and Postgraduate Local Scholarships open on Monday, 5 October 2026 and close on Friday, 27 November 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The GETFund Scholarship Programme overview states: 'The Program provides financial, social, and academic support to Scholars. Financial support includes tuition fees, accommodation, and scholastic materials.'
benefits: Financial, social and academic support to Scholars alongside the financial support
eligibility: Pursuing a Master's or PhD programme in the 2026/27 academic year (the Postgraduate Local Scholarship)
Applying through the official GETFund Scholarship Portal at scholarships.getfund.gov.gh
The Fund's scope covers 'brilliant but needy' applicants at undergraduate and postgraduate levels
Priority areas published by the Fund: STEM programmes and female education
requirements: Complete the online application form on the official GETFund Scholarship Portal with all required information
Upload scanned copies of the relevant supporting documents for vetting and shortlisting
Submit only through the official Scholarship Portal - applications sent through any other channel will not be processed
Read the full eligibility, application requirements and process details published on the portal before applying
documents: Scanned copies of the relevant supporting documents (the announcement does not itemise the list; full details are on the portal)
selection_criteria: Vetting and shortlisting of uploaded documents
'Brilliant but needy' framing within the Fund's published scope and priority areas (STEM, female education)
Shortlisted applicants are contacted once vetting and shortlisting are completed
application_method: Visit the official GETFund Scholarship Portal at scholarships.getfund.gov.gh
Create an account and complete the online application form with accurate information
Upload scanned copies of the relevant supporting documents
Submit through the portal before the closing date
official.application_route: Online only, via scholarships.getfund.gov.gh; submissions through any other channel are not processed.
official.citizenship_residency: Local (Ghanaian) scholarship scheme - GETFund's local scholarships for candidates pursuing programmes within Ghana; a separate foreign scholarship programme exists.
official.international_eligibility: No - this is a local scholarship for study within Ghana (the foreign programme is a separate scheme).
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Priority areas published by the Fund: STEM programmes and female education.
official.description: The Ghana Education Trust Fund, a statutory education fund, runs a scholarship programme providing financial, social and academic support to Scholars, with financial support covering tuition fees, accommodation and scholastic materials for 'brilliant but needy' applicants at undergraduate and postgraduate levels.

not_confirmed: funding_amount - GETFund publishes no award value for the scholarship
travel_coverage - travel is not among the published support items
documents - the announcement does not itemise the document list; it directs applicants to the portal
verification.notes: Rendered and read the official GETFund news announcement (2 October 2026: window 5 October - 27 November 2026, Master's and PhD for the postgraduate scheme, portal-only applications, scanned documents for vetting and shortlisting) and the official scholarship programme overview (tuition fees, accommodation, scholastic materials; brilliant-but-needy scope; STEM and female-education priorities). The site is a JavaScript application, so the pages were read in a browser.

applicant_utility.summary: The window is short and hard: GETFund's own announcement opens the 2026/27 Postgraduate Local Scholarship on Monday 5 October 2026 and closes it on Friday 27 November 2026, and applications are accepted only through scholarships.getfund.gov.gh - anything sent by another channel is simply not processed. What the Fund commits to publicly is tuition fees, accommodation and scholastic materials for 'brilliant but needy' Master's and PhD candidates studying within Ghana, with STEM and female education as its stated priority areas. Since GETFund publishes no award value, treat the support as covering those three items rather than a cash amount, and expect a vetting-and-shortlisting stage before any contact.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Ghanaian candidates admitted to or pursuing a 2026/27 Master's or PhD programme within Ghana who need tuition, accommodation and study-material support.
application_readiness_checklist: Create your account on scholarships.getfund.gov.gh well before 27 November 2026 and read the portal's full eligibility and process pages first
Scan every supporting document in advance at readable quality - the announcement tells applicants to prepare scans before starting
Confirm you fall within the postgraduate definition (Master's or PhD, 2026/27 academic year) before filing
Keep a direct line to GETFund: all official correspondence is between the Fund and the applicant, so watch your own email and phone
common_rejection_risks: Submitting through any channel other than the official portal - such applications are not processed
Leaving uploads to the final days; the closing date of 27 November 2026 leaves no room for failed scans or portal problems
Failing the vetting stage because supporting documents are missing or illegible
Assuming the undergraduate scheme's rules apply - the postgraduate scheme is Master's/PhD only for 2026/27
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The scheme publishes tuition, accommodation and scholastic materials only - travel, research fieldwork costs, data costs and general personal spending are not listed as covered, and no monetary value is published.
document_audit: The announcement does not list documents; the portal does - gather them from the portal, not from third-party summaries
Scans must be attached to the portal application; posting or emailing documents separately is not a submission
alerts: Closing date Friday 27 November 2026 with no stated extension mechanism
All official correspondence runs directly between GETFund and the applicant - beware of intermediaries claiming to process applications
The Fund separately warns that 2024/2025 beneficiaries who have not accepted awards risk forfeiture, showing it enforces offer-acceptance deadlines strictly
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Account creation and online form on scholarships.getfund.gov.gh, scanned-document upload, vetting and shortlisting by the Fund, then direct contact with shortlisted applicants.
